entry_sequence.transcript_quote: I used the rule of using the last candle before the impulse to mark my supply zones.
entry_sequence.action: Identify the initial supply or demand zone on the higher timeframe using the last candle before the impulse.
entry_sequence.rationale: The last candle before the impulse marks the zone where institutional buying or selling took place.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: What we can do is zoom in to the 1 hour time frame to identify smaller supply zones inside of this 4hour zone.
entry_sequence.action: Zoom into a lower timeframe (e.g., 1H) to identify smaller supply or demand zones inside the initial higher timeframe zone.
entry_sequence.rationale: Refining the zone to a smaller timeframe allows for a more precise entry and amplified risk-to-reward.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: The extreme zone is going to be the furthest zone from price in the leg of price movement.
entry_sequence.action: Select the 'extreme zone,' which is the zone furthest from price within the current leg of price movement.
entry_sequence.rationale: The extreme zone is chosen because it offers the best risk-reward and is considered the safest entry point.

entry_sequence.action: Wait for the lower timeframe structure to change in agreement with the larger trend direction (Standard Confirmation).

entry_sequence.rationale: Entering at the refined zone captures the wick and secures a sniper entry.
